The arrow from O to P1 is located in the upper right and is labeled "influence of climate factors", indicating that when affected by climate factors alone, the center of gravity migrates eastward and northward; the arrow from O to P2 is located in the lower right and is labeled "influence of a certain human factor", indicating that when affected by this human factor alone, the center of gravity migrates eastward and southward. On the figure, the northward component of OP1 is obviously greater than the southward component of OP2. Then reason: the combined action is equivalent to synthesizing the migration directions caused by the two factors. In the east-west direction, both climate factors and human factors have eastward components, so after synthesis it must be eastward; in the north-south direction, the northward component of climate factors is greater than the southward component of human factors, and after offsetting it still appears northward. Therefore from 1980 to 2000, China's land-cover center of gravity migrated toward the northeast under the combined action of the two factors.
